stem: He will never forget the days ____ he spent with you in Hainan.
reason: spent后缺宾语，关系词指days，用that；when只作时间状语，不能补spend的宾语。

stem: Jim told his daughter that she could have ____ she wanted for Christmas.
reason: have后为宾语从句，whatever既引导从句又作wanted的宾语，表示她想要的任何东西。

stem: David couldn't find the bank and asked the policeman ____.
reason: asked为过去，从句通常用过去时；宾语从句保持陈述语序where it was，不用where was it。

stem: Harry got high marks in the test, ____ surprised everyone in our class.
reason: 逗号后的非限定性定语从句指前面取得高分这件事，用which作surprised的主语，不能用that。

stem: This is one of the best books ____ we have ever read this term.
reason: books受最高级best修饰，考试通常推荐that作read的宾语；which在现代限定性从句中也可成立，保留A、C多解提示。

stem: Do you know ____ he will go to Ann's birthday party on Friday or not?
reason: whether … or not表示是否，询问会不会参加；that不表达不确定的是否。

stem: After having lived in New York City for thirty years, Tom finally returned to the small town ____ he grew up.
reason: grow up不缺宾语，从句缺地点状语，where指在那个小镇成长。
